_comment: Per-site identity configuration. The ROC table MUST be measured on this site's own enrolment data and cameras: a curve from the vendor's benchmark does not describe your lighting, your mounting angles or your population.

roster._comment: TTL must exceed the longest plausible shift. Too short and people vanish from the roster mid-shift, then read as unaccounted presences. With exit readers, set this longer still and rely on badge-out.

threshold_policy._comment: target is per DECISION, not per comparison. Per-comparison requirement is derived as target/N. Run ThresholdPolicy.max_candidates() at commissioning: beyond that many candidates, tier 2 cannot decide at all.
